query: INSERT INTO tache (id, nature, sujet, cabinet_cible, dossier_cible, etat, cree_le, prochaine_tentative) SELECT gen_random_uuid(), 'notification', 'retard_horodatage', t.cabinet_cible, t.dossier_cible, 'en_attente', $2, $2 FROM tache t WHERE t.nature = 'horodatage' AND t.etat <> 'terminee' AND t.cree_le <= $1 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tache n WHERE n.sujet = 'retard_horodatage' AND n.cabinet_cible = t.cabinet_cible AND n.dossier_cible = t.dossier_cible AND n.cree_le > $1) GROUP BY t.cabinet_cible, t.dossier_cible ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING RETURNING cabinet_cible, dossier_cible AS "dossier_cible!"
